Name: Baseline acceptance
Required evidence: Accepted mission, exclusions, budget accounting, five decisions, role appointments, assumption dispositions
Permitted release: Documentation work only; no purchase authorization

Name: Software baseline
Authority: Faisal Farouq plus named workflow/security reviewers
Required evidence: Laptop demo, fictional-data boundary, consent, audit, medication and report tests JB-V-10 to 19 and 21
Permitted release: Low-cost software expenditure only after owner spending authorization

Name: Architecture and facility readiness
Authority: Named independent mechanical controls electrical and rigging reviewers
Required evidence: Frozen ten-joint CAD interfaces; mass allocation; facility and fall envelope; support concept; hazard dispositions
Permitted release: Request quotes and detailed fabrication bids; no expensive order

Name: Procurement release
Authority: Faisal Farouq plus independent engineering reviewer
Required evidence: Accepted requirements; torque-speed/duty/thermal/power models; simulated standing and three-step evidence; vendor data; landed BOM <=10000 USD; interface drawings; named fabricator; inspection plan
Permitted release: Specific BOM lines only, signed amount and configuration; no generic purchasing authority

Name: Fabrication release
Authority: Named qualified fabricator and independent reviewer
Required evidence: Released drawings; material/load-path calculations; stop/support design; incoming inspection; fabrication process and inspection plan
Permitted release: Named authorized shop and released revision only

Name: Fixture and electrical acceptance
Authority: Named test director and controls/electrical reviewers
Required evidence: Stage 2 sensors; 3 actuator module; 4 power; 5 safety; 6 joint; 7 fixture leg evidence; stop-time and load-retention acceptance
Permitted release: Restrained unloaded integration only under test permit

Name: Supported locomotion progression
Authority: Named test director and mechanical/rigging reviewers
Required evidence: Stage 8 lower body; 9 standing; 10 weight shift; 11 single step; 12 three steps; 13 repeat; separate passed evidence at each stage
Permitted release: Only next approved motion stage within documented limits

Name: Handling and enclosure acceptance
Authority: Named handling reviewer and test director
Required evidence: Stage 14 stationary handling; stage 15 shell clearance and thermal evidence; physical isolation from gait
Permitted release: Supported handling and approved enclosed motion configurations only

Name: Integrated research release
Authority: Faisal Farouq plus independent evidence reviewer
Required evidence: Stage 16 complete caregiver demo; all verification outcomes reviewed; limitations, costs, configuration and release archive
Permitted release: Controlled research demonstration under signed test plan; no public/patient operation approval
